CONSOLIDATION + REPAIR slice (three files, all currently written but wrong).
BACKGROUND: these were written before daemon-protocol.ts was ported, so they carry local copies of types that now have a real home in crates/pi-coding-agent/src/modes/daemon/daemon_protocol.rs.
FIX 1 (daemon_client.rs): DELETE the whole inner `pub(crate) mod protocol { ... }` block near the top of the file. In the TypeScript, daemon-client.ts imports those items FROM ./daemon-protocol.js and does NOT redeclare them (verified: zero export overlap between the two TS files). So replace every `protocol::X` / `self::protocol::X` reference with `super::daemon_protocol::X` (or `crate::modes::daemon::daemon_protocol::X`), keeping only what is genuinely client-only: DaemonClient, DaemonClientError, DaemonClientReconnectStatus, DaemonClientReconnectOptions, DaemonClientRequestOptions, DaemonTransportClient, DaemonHello (as the TS declares them), DaemonCapabilityUnavailableError, DaemonSocketClosedError, getDaemonSocketCloseReason, DaemonCommandBody, the listener type aliases, and the request/reconnect logic. daemon_protocol.rs owns everything else (DaemonCommand, DaemonResponse, DaemonProtocolInfo, DaemonEventCursor, daemonCommandCompatibility, createDaemonCommandEnvelope, isDaemonCommandEnvelope, salvageDaemonCommandId, createDaemonEventMeta, createDaemonEventEnvelope, createDaemonReplayInfo, the capability constants and the DAEMON_* constants).
FIX 2 (heartbeat_catalog.rs and saved_session_catalog.rs): both have a stale private helper that constructs a DaemonErrorResponse - that type does NOT exist. The real function is `crate::modes::daemon::daemon_errors::deserialize_daemon_error(&DaemonResponse) -> DaemonError` (it already takes the whole response, exactly like the TS `deserializeDaemonError(response)`). So change the body of `daemon_error_from_response` in BOTH files to: `let error = deserialize_daemon_error(response); DaemonClientError::Message(error.message())` and drop the now-unused DaemonErrorResponse import. Keep the same behaviour: the TS throws the error for a non-success response (if !response.success -> throw deserializeDaemonError(response)).
FIX 3: those two files also import from `super::daemon_client::protocol::{...}` - repoint those to `super::daemon_protocol::{...}`.
GENERAL: do NOT delete the `#[cfg(test)]` modules and do NOT change any public function signature. Do NOT touch daemon_protocol.rs itself (owned by ca-daemon-a) - read it to get the exact names.
Build note: under MSYS bash pass the job count by exporting it (`export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4`), do not inline it.
FINISH with ONE `cargo check -p pi-coding-agent` and ONE `cargo test -p pi-coding-agent`.
